note: Liquidity paper alerts (Kalshi + Novig + Polymarket public books), newest first. Trigger: >= $25000 (and >= 10% of the side's prior size, capped at $100k) of NEW bids within 3c of the best bid on one side since the last check, >= 3x any new money on the other side, leaving that side heavier; main lines only (ML 15-85c, spread/total 30-70c), pregame; Kalshi moneylines combined per game. Spoof filter: logged only if >= 75% of the new money is still there on the next check (confirmed_after_min). pulled = the new money later disappeared before the game. rule_met = another book has >= $10000 on the same side and it is the heavier side there. sharp_agree/sharp_oppose = sharp-monitor (Pinnacle move) alerts on the same game & market. price = cost to buy the side when logged (0-1); close_price = last pregame price; clv_cents = close_price - price (positive = the market moved toward this side). result W/L/P/VOID from the exchange's settlement; units_flat = 1u at price.
